reviews.body: Reviewed against #688. The warnings are emitted with `HarnessDeprecationWarning` and `stacklevel=2`, both maintained docs (spend README and docs/spend.md) carry the same migration text, the warnings themselves are tested via `pytest.warns`, and every internal caller including the Redis integration tests migrated to `get_many`/`add_many` so the suite stays warning-clean. Verified locally: 219 passed, merges clean with current main.

title: Warn on the deprecated single-key `get`/`add` of `InMemorySpendStore` and `RedisSpendStore`
